title: A doubly stochastic renewal framework for partitioning spiking variability
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Estimate spike-generation irregularity phi from spike trains alone and compare against voltage-derived operational-time ISI CV² for the paper’s Fig. 3 intracellular validation. The contribution phi/CVraw² is a biological quantity, not a score to maximize.

success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
